text:
alex_k: CI buildx push failing on canary-frontend, started after I merged the Dockerfile change that switches to the new base image. Can someone eyeball?

alex_k: CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4821 (fail at push stage)

ci-bot: build 4821 · canary-frontend · stage=push · status=failed

maria_g: dropping in — paste the error log? quick glance: did we rotate registry creds yesterday?

alex_k: log excerpt:
```
# docker buildx build --push --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t registry.internal.redwood.com/canary-frontend:pr-842
ERROR: failed to push to registry: failed to put manifest list: manifest invalid: annotation mismatch for platform linux/arm64
  expected mediaType=application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json
  got application/vnd.docker.image.rootfs.diff.tar.gzip
```

samir: hmm that's odd — looks like the manifest list entry for arm64 ended up being a raw layer manifest instead of a platform manifest. usually happens if buildx produced a single-arch manifest and buildkit tried to stitch a list but got mismatched media types.

maria_g: we did rotate the registry token yesterday afternoon for the ephemeral CI service account, but ops-bot said rollouts completed. Could be unrelated but good to check.

ops-bot: registry-auth rotation completed 2026-11-02T21:40Z. No failures reported on registry side.

samir: two quick repro/triage things: 1) try clearing the buildkit cache on the builder node (we've seen stale cache produce weird manifests) 2) try buildx with --no-cache and --progress=plain to get full logs.

alex_k: trying a rerun now with --no-cache. will also run a local build with buildctl to see layer types.

alex_k: local reproduce output:
```
$ buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=. --local dockerfile=. --output type=image,name=registry.internal.redwood.com/canary-frontend:local,push=true
# push fails similarly:
failed to push to registry: unexpected media type for manifest: application/vnd.docker.image.rootfs.diff.tar.gzip
```

maria_g: could this be the new base image manifest is itself a schema1/artifact that confuses buildkit? which base did you switch to?

alex_k: switched base from redwood/python:3.11-slim to internal/python-optimized:3.11 which is a multi-arch image served by our internal mirror.

samir: that could be it — if the mirror serves nonstandard media types or a corrupt manifest it can cascade. Can you pull the base image manifest and inspect? e.g. `skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry.internal.redwood.com/internal/python-optimized:3.11 | jq .`

alex_k: pulled raw manifest, snippet:
```
{
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "mediaType": "application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json",
  "manifests": [ ... , {"platform": {"architecture": "arm64"}, "mediaType": "application/vnd.docker.image.rootfs.diff.tar.gzip", "digest": "sha256:abc..."}]
}
```

maria_g: yeah that's the problem — the mirror's arm64 manifest entry has the wrong mediaType. should be application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json for a manifest object, not rootfs layer.

ops-bot: registry mirror node mcr-02 shows recent sync job that converted manifests during mirroring, job id sync-1103.

samir: flagged ops to revert sync converter for that repo. For immediate fix: 1) force buildx to pull the amd64/arm64 manifest as images (not rely on the mirror's list) by using --platform=linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 separately and pushing single-arch images, then create a manifest list with `buildx imagetools create`. Or 2) re-tag with a corrected manifest on the mirror.

maria_g: re-tagging mirror sounds like ops work. Alex, can you try the single-arch push workaround so the canary doesn't block?

alex_k: attempting single-arch pushes now. running two parallel jobs to push amd64 then arm64 and then create list.

ci-bot: build 4821 · canary-frontend · rerun #1 (single-arch pipeline) started

alex_k: quick note — buildkit cache still had a reused layer that matched digest but because manifest types differ, pushing single-arch bypassed the list stitching and worked. pushed both arch images, then: `buildx imagetools create --tag registry.internal.redwood.com/canary-frontend:pr-842 registry.internal.redwood.com/canary-frontend:pr-842-amd64 registry.internal.redwood.com/canary-frontend:pr-842-arm64`

ci-bot: build 4821-rerun completed: pushed images and created manifest list via imagetools. canary tag updated.

maria_g: nice. ops — can you follow up on the mirror sync job to stop rewriting mediaType fields? This will break other repos.

ops-bot: created ticket REG-987: investigate mirror sync converter. Assigned to @samir_ops.

samir: I'll take it. immediate next steps: (a) revert sync-1103 for internal/python-optimized, (b) scan recent mirror syncs for other repos with mismatched mediaTypes, (c) add a validation step to reject altered mediaType entries.

alex_k: thanks all — unblocked for the canary. I'll include notes in the PR about the workaround and link REG-987.

maria_g: thanks — please ping if the single-arch create steps need automating in the pipeline as a fallback.

alex_k: will do. :thumbsup:
